**Verdict: PASS.** Candidate `sha256:c05864ba…314f5023c` (source `2495e036`, 2769 files) matched both in the repository and in a disposable clone. HEAD `895b1e43b` only adds the freeze metadata.

**F-DG6-740 (Low): CLOSED_VERIFIED.**
- **Reproduction:** I re-ran my round-11 test on the real demo stack, in English and Arabic, with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8 (30/30 each time).
- **Stale token:** pasting another rule's token now gets the 422 problem text in the form's single alert ("…so nothing was saved…" / "…لذلك لم يُحفظ أي شيء…", right-to-left in Arabic). The false "This rule changed after you opened it" no longer appears.
- **Rest of the flow:** the form reloads the rule's own token, and the next save succeeds. A new step with a pre-0127 token gives the same result.
- **409 path:** a real concurrent change (409) still shows the "changed, re-apply" message and not the stale-token text.
- **Mutants:** reverting the fix fails 6 of 15 tests in the candidate's web test. Showing the stale-token alert on a 409 fails 2.

**New findings: none.**

**Runs (all in disposable clones):**

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks | Build, typecheck, OpenAPI (932 operations), no-CDN and contrast pass. Lint and format first failed, but only on my own untracked probe files that I had copied into the clone too early. On the candidate's own files both pass. |
| Unit tests: Node 24.21.0 and 22.22.0, both locales | Every test passes. Two runs exited 1 on a Vitest worker timeout under load around 20, after all tests had passed. Re-run alone, both exit 0. |
| Integration, run twice | 439/439 files each time. 119 migrations (0001–0127). 932 of 932 operations validated, 0 pending. |
| `tests/qa` alone | 45 integration files (437 tests) and 6 unit files (61 tests) pass. |
| Product e2e | 556 passed in each locale. I split each run into two halves to stay under the 2-hour task limit. The 2 skips are the keyboard walkthrough, which needs demo data and passes on the demo stack. |
| Root acceptance e2e | 288 passed in each locale. All 18 skips are the declared a20-p6-axe "not scanned" routes. |
| Demo e2e | 30 passed in each locale. |
| My stack probes | 30 passed in each locale: auditor read-only, 360/390 px and 200 % text, a 400 shown in the selected language, row counts, cleared storage, detail-screen axe, XSS. |
| Token probes and earlier mutants | The API token probe passes 23/23, and the round-11 mutants Z1, Z2, M2, W1 and L1 are all still caught. |
| Reliability | The A13 kill-and-restart drills and the D-203 batch tests pass. |
| Validator | Historical DG5 to DG1, register DG6 and pipeline all pass. |
| Load and export (provisional, one shared sandbox host) | p95: reads 18.3 ms, updates 29.1 ms, dashboards 39.8 ms, export start 34.8 ms. LOAD-T20 failed again: the load dataset has no second user in the same scope (same known gap as round 11). The same-scope requester-only check passes in `exports.test.ts`. |

**Open questions (D-236): not defects.**
- **D-229:** connector configuration text is written only by the technical admin role. No system path puts a record id there. A reader could only learn a hidden id if a privileged writer deliberately typed it in, which is the same as any free-text field.
- **D-228 (4):** my sweep of the 66 screens a team lead opens finds no restricted id, in either language or locale.
- **Token sequences:** none of the sequences I tried loses or misplaces a hidden literal.

**Drifts from the assignment:**
- The record says `round: 12`, not the assignment's `round: 7`, to match the round folder.
- Node 22.22.0 is installed, not the 22.22.2 the assignment names.
- Migrations run to 0127, not 0125.
